persons.name: Viṣṇusiṃha
persons.evidence: daivajñaviṣṇusiṃhena bhaktāpuranivāsinā (!) || sastaṃ goviṃdanāmārthaṃ saṃpūrṇṇalikhitaṃ tvidaṃ

date.as_written: nepāle hāyane jāte dhaneśe nayanārṇṇave | site tapasya sutithau harauvāre vṛspatau

notes: The catalogue lists Goviṃda as the scribe, but the colophon clearly indicates that Daivajña Viṣṇusiṃha of Bhaktapur was the scribe who wrote the manuscript for the sake of/commissioned by Goviṃda (goviṃdanāmārthaṃ saṃpūrṇṇalikhitaṃ tvidaṃ).
